library(ArchR)

library(furrr)

library(cowplot)

library(scCustomize)
library(rtracklayer)
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("COLQUITTLAB_UTILS", "/opt/colquittlab/utils"), "R", "common_aesthetics.R"))
source(here::here("config/paths.R"))
source(here::here("multiome/archr/hybrid_labels.R"))
pnames = names(position_colors)
names(position_colors) = case_when(pnames == "nido" ~ "nr",
                                     pnames == "ncl" ~ "nc",
                                     TRUE ~ pnames)

pnames2 = names(position_colors2)

                                   TRUE ~ pnames2)

```{r}
proj_dir = ARCHR_PROJ_DIR
script_name = "peaks_gaba-glut_hybrid"
out_dir = here::here("multiome/archr", script_name)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = T)


out_bed_fname = file.path(out_dir, "Glut_vs_GABA_enriched.bed" )
addArchRThreads(threads = 36) 
```

```{r}
proj = loadArchRProject(proj_dir)
## Hybrid-scheme labels, in memory only -- see multiome/archr/hybrid_labels.R.
## Drops the artefactual Glut-Nido-3 cells, which have no hybrid label.
proj = add_cluster_hybrid(proj)

```

### Export beds
```{r}
bed_dir = file.path(out_dir, "beds")  ## own directory; never the shared project
dir.create(bed_dir)
```

## Differential peaks
```{r}
plan(multisession(workers = 4))
```

### Glut vs. GABA
```{r}
# Group all Glut-* clusters vs all GABA-* clusters. The hybrid names no longer
# encode "Pre", so the two excluded precursor clusters are named explicitly --
# see hybrid_groups$glut_broadclass in multiome/archr/hybrid_labels.R.
proj$BroadClass <- case_when(
  proj$cluster_hybrid %in% hybrid_groups$glut_broadclass ~ "Glut",
  proj$cluster_hybrid %in% hybrid_groups$gaba ~ "GABA",
  TRUE ~ "other"
)

markersPeaks <- getMarkerFeatures(
  ArchRProj  = proj,
  useMatrix  = "PeakMatrix",
  groupBy    = "BroadClass",
  testMethod = "wilcoxon",
  bias       = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
)

# Extract Glut-enriched peaks (high in Glut, low in GABA)
glut_markers <- getMarkers(markersPeaks, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC >= 1",
                            returnGR = TRUE)$Glut

export(glut_markers, out_bed_fname, format = "BED")

```
